query: Scrub this Discussion of generic AI-writing tells -- throat-clearing, 'not only X but also Y', 'leverage', 'deep dive' -- but keep the hedges that are actually warranted
can you de-slop my abstract? it reads like an LLM wrote it ('It turns out...', 'game-changer', 'only time will tell')
Audit the Introduction for uncited claims like 'research suggests' and 'it is well established that' and give me P0/P1/P2 severities
Our reviewer said the manuscript 'sounds AI-generated'. Find the tells in manuscript/main.md and rewrite them without changing meaning
check for synonym drift: we defined 'ventilator-free days' and I think later sections call it 'days off the vent' and 'VFDs' inconsistently
Flag every non-definitional em-dash and every 'significant/substantial/robust' not backed by a statistic in this Results paragraph
I'm drafting the cover letter and limitations paragraph; run the anti-slop catalog on them, P0 first
Is 'In this section, we will describe...' and 'As we'll see' OK in a JAMA Network Open paper? Clean up meta-commentary in the draft
Please do the anti-slop pass only (not the full pre-submission gate) on the Discussion -- remove empty conclusions like 'the future looks bright'
remove AI writing tells from this grant specific aims page but keep the passive voice in the approach/methods part
Run the full pre-submission audit across voice, Methods/Results discipline, and anti-slop before I send this to my co-authors
Move the interpretive sentences out of my Results section into the Discussion and keep Results strictly factual
Rewrite this Discussion in a clinically detached NEJM AI house style with authorial 'we' and calibrated verbs
Draft the full manuscript from our frozen results and SAP for a STROBE cohort study
Add Zotero citation fields to the DOCX and repair broken references
Review analysis/sap.md for clarity, gaps, and scope creep
Find PubMed citations supporting the claim that early mobilization reduces delirium
Write a response-to-reviewers letter addressing the three methodological critiques
Check whether our reporting follows STROBE and which checklist items are missing
Fix the figure legend so it only describes what's plotted and the table footnotes define abbreviations
